title: Device study: the drawn phone vs a real iPhone bezel vs the generic 3D phone
brief: Not an ad: a side-by-side test of the phone frames (demo first, the founder picks). The same real screens (Emma's Wardrobe tab, the scan-roll footage) in the old drawn PhoneFrame, Apple's official iPhone Product Bezels (as is: an establishing shot, then a slow push-in, the only kind of move Apple allows) and Curate's generic 3D phone (a slow orbit with reflections moving over the glass). 1080x1920, 60 fps, 6 s, silent.
disclosures: Study only, never posted. The track is listed because ad.json needs one; the study is silent.
notes: Render: node ads/_demos/device-study/render.ts (stages the assets, renders every option with --gl=angle into ads/_demos/device-study/out/).
